parlay.note: Same-game legs are not independent. Use the phi value to adjust a 2-leg same-game parlay: P = p1p2 + rho*sqrt(p1(1-p1)p2(1-p2)).

gate_definitions.rule: Every input file pinned by URL and sha256.
Rule fixed before evaluation; no threshold search.
Positive ROI across the two most recent seasons.
Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.10 against break-even win rate.
At least 60% of tested seasons positive.
Max drawdown no worse than -25 units.

rewards.model: Points are awarded for statistically defensible performance, not raw ROI: 100 x max(0, lower 95% ROI bound) + 20 x seasons positive + 10 x gates passed. Strategies failing G3 (n<100) score zero. No cash, no prizes: this is a paper competition. Legal review is required before any real reward.
